project_type: React 18 SPA with Vite 5, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Supabase backend
build_system: Vite 5 with prerender script (vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs)
test_framework: No test framework installed - verification via build only
build_command: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/emo-websitenew && rm -rf dist && npm run build
test_command: N/A - no test suite, build is the gate (must produce 398 pages and exit 0)
verification_instructions: Run build command, confirm exit code 0 and 398 pages rendered
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated during build but not checked in (.gitignore). No snapshot files.
setup_instructions: Node 22 at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin, npm deps already installed in node_modules
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Do NOT install @tiptap/* packages (breaks site with blank page). Use existing RichMarkdownEditor (textarea + toolbar).
contribution_requirements: Build must produce 398 pages. No TipTap. Admin pages are lazy-loaded and not prerendered.

key_patterns.admin_pages: Each admin page is in src/pages/admin/, lazy-imported in App.jsx, routes under /admin/*. Uses getAdminClient() for Supabase writes. Header has nav links to other admin sections + logout button.
key_patterns.admin_auth: AdminLogin.jsx checks hardcoded username/password (admin/emo@2026), then validates Supabase service key stored in sessionStorage.
key_patterns.markdown_editor: RichMarkdownEditor component at src/components/admin/RichMarkdownEditor.jsx - textarea with toolbar buttons for bold, H2, H3, bullets, quotes, links, tables, HR.
key_patterns.legal_pages: PrivacyPolicy.jsx etc. use LegalLayout component with sections=[{h, body[], list[]}] structure. Pure data passed as props.
key_patterns.supabase_client: src/lib/supabase.js (anon key, read-only) and src/lib/supabaseAdmin.js (service key from sessionStorage, full access).
key_patterns.careers_page: Uses useJobOpenings() hook to fetch from job_openings table. Renders expandable JobCard components with markdown content via markdownToBlocks + ArticleBlocks.

directory_structure: src/pages/admin/ - admin panel pages; src/pages/ - public pages; src/components/ - shared components; src/hooks/ - data fetching hooks; src/lib/ - supabase clients; src/utils/ - utility functions; supabase/ - SQL schema files
